column5: Look: bright, cartoon 3D, low-poly with rounded chunky shapes; golden sandstone walls with şəbəkə lattice windows and wooden balconies, red-and-blue carpets with buta patterns, blue Caspian sky, Qız Qalası standing on the horizon. Cırtdan is tiny with a red papaq, patterned vest and a patched bread sack; the Div is big, furry, horned, round-bellied, with a club, comic not scary. Warm late-afternoon light. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
References: the GDD's own pages (characters, place, power-ups); the genre's 3D lane runners for timing and lane width only.
View: 3D · Camera: fixed behind and above the runner, looking down the street.
3 stone-street lanes, auto-run that speeds up, swipe and key controls

Jump and slide, with obstacles that each ask for one move: baskets and jugs (jump), carpet on ropes (slide), bazaar stalls (lane change), parked phaetons (lane change or ramp onto the roof), oncoming camel caravan, city-gate tunnel
The Div chasing behind: a side bump brings him close, a second one catches you
Yağ çörəyi in lines and arcs; rare nar
Power-ups: grandma's tray (magnet), magic çarıq (super jump), flying carpet (one-hit shield, double tap) (thin stand-in)
Score = distance × multiplier; best score kept between visits
Old-Baku scenery: sandstone houses, balconies, carpets, Qız Qalası on the skyline
Title, pause, mute, game over with continue-with-nar and restart
Div chasing behind · in the slice
Power-ups (Simurq, sehrli çarıq, nənənin sinisi, qoşa təndir, uçan xalça, kəndirbaz çubuğu) · thin stand-in *(guessed)*
Nar to continue after a crash · thin stand-in *(guessed)*
Score multiplier from missions · thin stand-in *(guessed)*
The title shows Cırtdan, grandma's line and the controls.
Enter or a tap: the Div bursts out behind and the run starts slow on an empty street with a row of bread to collect.
The first obstacles come one at a time with a beat to read each: a pile of baskets to jump, a carpet on a rope to slide under, a parked phaeton to swerve round.
By 40 seconds a ramp leads onto phaeton roofs with bread along them, and the first camel caravan walks toward you in one lane.
A side bump makes the Div loom up and the edges glow red; he drops back after a few seconds: the hook pays off.
The street is safe for the first 8 seconds; the first real trouble, two lanes blocked at once, comes at about 45 seconds.
Speed rises steadily to a cap around 2.5 minutes.
A head-on hit with a phaeton or caravan, or two side bumps close together, ends the run; a nar can be spent once per run to continue.
Later chunks mix moving caravans with roof routes and tunnels.
